html:
SMTO-GML-0062 — SMTO needs a valid label or category for these emails

GUID: a1f5ac7e-9666-4015-b1e8-25cc5d9e909b
Slug: gmail-client-action-input-invalid
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gmail-client-actions

What happened

  • The request to label, move or recategorize emails didn't name a usable destination: no label was given, more than one label was given for a move, or the category isn't one of Gmail's tabs. No email was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell SMTO the exact name of the label to use, as it appears in Gmail's label list. SMTO only uses labels you have already created and won't guess or invent one.
  2. When moving emails, name exactly one label. A move puts each email in one place, so SMTO needs a single destination.
  3. When changing a category, choose one of Primary, Social, Promotions, Updates or Forums. These are the only category tabs Gmail supports.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows how many emails it will change and the label or category you named.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't let SMTO create a new label or apply the change to your whole mailbox to work around this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail label action validation failed: no user label supplied, move_to_label not given exactly one label, or set_category not one of CATEGORY_PERSONAL, CATEGORY_SOCIAL, CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS, CATEGORY_UPDATES or CATEGORY_FORUMS.

What this means

  • Label actions require user labels; moving to a label requires exactly one destination. Category changes accept only the documented category constants. Validation precedes selection writes.

Why this can happen

  • Label actions require user labels; moving to a label requires exactly one destination. Category changes accept only the documented category constants. Validation precedes selection writes.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected account, action arguments and operation reference; do not infer mailbox effects from the error alone.

How to fix it

  • Supply labels with exact user-label names or IDs (exactly one for move_to_label), or a documented CATEGORY_ constant for set_category. Validation in gmail/workflows.label_changes runs before selection and any write.
  • Supply the exact label name or ID, or a documented CATEGORY_ value for set_category.

Retry and execution caution

  • Supply the exact label name or ID, or a documented CATEGORY_ value for set_category.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected action validates before selecting mail.

What not to do

  • Do not invent a destination label or reinterpret a missing label as the whole mailbox.

Technical notes

  • This check rejects new work before its write. It does not undo previous confirmed effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
